patterns.name: Unrestricted Mint Capability
patterns.description: Mint function without proper access control can inflate token supply
patterns.recommendation: Restrict mint to authorized accounts and add supply cap checks

patterns.name: Admin Can Freeze Accounts
patterns.description: Admin can freeze user accounts, preventing transfers
patterns.recommendation: Add timelock or multi-sig requirement for freeze operations

patterns.name: Unrestricted Burn of User Tokens
patterns.description: Admin can burn tokens from any user's account
patterns.recommendation: Only allow users to burn their own tokens

patterns.name: Hidden Fee Extraction
patterns.description: Transfer function silently takes fees to admin account
patterns.recommendation: Make all fee mechanisms transparent and verifiable

patterns.name: Emergency Withdraw All
patterns.description: Function that can drain all funds from the module to admin
patterns.recommendation: Remove arbitrary withdrawal or add governance approval requirement

patterns.name: Upgradeable Module Without Governance
patterns.description: Module can be upgraded by single admin without governance approval
patterns.recommendation: Require multi-sig or DAO governance for module upgrades

patterns.name: Dynamic Dispatch via Phantom Types
patterns.description: Using phantom type parameters to hide execution paths
patterns.recommendation: Audit all phantom type usage for hidden execution paths

patterns.name: Mutable Shared Object Manipulation
patterns.description: Shared objects with unrestricted mutation can be exploited
patterns.recommendation: Restrict mutation of shared objects to authorized parties

patterns.name: Hidden Admin Capability
patterns.description: Admin capabilities stored in non-transparent locations
patterns.recommendation: Document all admin capabilities and make them publicly queryable

patterns.name: Unrestricted Object Transfer
patterns.description: Objects can be transferred without proper authorization checks
patterns.recommendation: Add authorization checks before object transfers

patterns.name: Integer Overflow Risk
patterns.recommendation: Use checked arithmetic or add explicit overflow guards

patterns.name: Missing Signer Verification
patterns.description: Entry function doesn't verify the signer parameter
patterns.recommendation: Always verify signer identity with signer::address_of

patterns.name: Unprotected Init Function
patterns.description: Initialization function can be called multiple times
patterns.recommendation: Ensure init can only be called once using a flag or module init pattern

patterns.name: Flash Loan Vulnerability
patterns.recommendation: Enforce repayment within the same transaction using hot potato pattern
